newsitem.title: USA: PolyGram to reorganize U.S. management-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: PolyGram to reorganize U.S. management-WSJ.

text.p: Music giant PolyGram NV is planning a reorganization within management ranks at its U.S. music operations, The Wall Street Journal said.

In Friday's electronic edition, the paper said that while final plans are being worked out by PolyGram executives, the company is expected to elevate Danny Goldberg, president and chief executive of its Mercury Records unit, to a broader corporate role overseeing several U.S. music labels.
The article said a company spokesman declined to comment on the changes, which could include cutbacks at PolyGram's Motown Records label, which has a staff of about 100, the article said.
